mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 6% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k jobs per month, a tightening labor market signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 6% and PAYEMS growth > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO reading above 95 indicates a rebounding industrial sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window with INDPRO > 95.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST exceeding 10% YoY signals a surging housing market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of months with HOUST YoY growth > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are both rising, an inflationary environment with tightening monetary policy signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rising.

mechanism_narrative: An UNRATE reading above 10% indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window with UNRATE > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly RSAFS reading below 300 billion signals reduced consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with RSAFS < 300 billion.
